prompt:
A desktop website first viewport for a Brazilian church portal, designed as a full-screen photographic CONTACT SHEET. This is a designed web page screenshot, not a poster and not a photograph with text on it.

TAKE FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGE ONLY: the palette (graphite ground #16181B, mount white #FFFFFF, archival paper #EFEDE7, ink red #8C2B21 as the single signal colour, archival gray #7A8085), the precise grotesque typography with tabular figures, the hand-inked caption lettering, the white album corner mounts, the hairline register marks, and the square-cornered flat plate components with no shadows and no rounded corners. DO NOT reuse the reference's composition: it has one big hero photograph with a plate at lower-left; this one must be completely different.

STRUCTURE, region by region, top to bottom:
1. A single hairline row of small uppercase navigation across the very top on archival paper #EFEDE7, with a thin rule beneath it. At the left end the wordmark IB CONECTA. Items, all visible, no hamburger: PLANEJE SUA VISITA, PEDIDO DE ORACAO with a cedilla and tilde, QUERO CONHECER, CONTRIBUIR, AGENDA, SERMOES with a tilde, AO VIVO, NOTICIAS with an acute accent, ENTRAR.
2. Below it, the ENTIRE remaining frame is a dense contact-sheet grid of archival photographic frames, roughly six columns by three rows, edge to edge with narrow archival-paper gutters and small hairline register crosses at the grid intersections. Every photograph fills its own cell completely. Under each photograph sits a short hand-inked caption in small dark lettering.
3. Inset into that grid, occupying a block about two cells wide and two cells tall in the upper-left area of the grid, a solid mount white plate held by four white album corner mounts. Inside it, a small uppercase label PROXIMO CULTO with an acute accent, then very large in graphite Domingo as 19h with a grave accent on the a, then smaller Santa Leopoldina - ES, then smallest Igreja Batista em Santa Leopoldina. This inverted white plate must be the single most dominant element on the screen, larger and brighter than any photograph.
4. Directly beneath that white plate, filling one grid cell exactly, a solid ink red #8C2B21 plate whose whole area is the primary action, white uppercase type reading PLANEJE SUA VISITA. Beside it, filling the neighbouring cell, a white-outlined plate on graphite reading FALAR NO WHATSAPP DA IGREJA.
5. Two other cells in the grid are inverted as archival paper plates instead of photographs, each holding a small dense list under a hairline-ruled small-caps heading: one AGENDA with three short dated rows, one SERMOES with three short dated rows, dates as tabular figures.
6. In the bottom-left cell of the grid, small uppercase lettering on archival paper reads the handle at igrejabatista.santaleopoldina.

The photographs are warm documentary black-and-white-leaning images of a small church community and a Brazilian mountain town: a small congregation seated indoors, an open Bible, a street of colonial houses with tiled roofs, people talking after a service, coffee cups being served, a green foggy valley, a wooden footbridge, hands holding a hymn book, an empty simple chapel interior. Muted, real, unstaged. No lit worship stage, no coloured spotlights, no backlit raised hands, no stock-slick smiling models.

The page must feel deliberately dense and full of real information, with no empty margin anywhere. Portuguese text only, with correct Brazilian Portuguese accents. Do not render any phone number, any PIX key, any attendance figure, any testimonial, any price, any logo mark, or any service time other than Domingo as 19h.
